A '''class-3 toxic weapons dump''' was a category of toxic weapons dumps.

==History==
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], a class-3 toxic weapons dump was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyara]]. A team of [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] hired by [[Nom Anor]] [[Raid on Nyara|raided]] the dump to retrieve a chunk of [[zinethium]].
